summary.text: Gary Daniels is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 43, where he assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former state senator and long-serving legislator, he is an insurance agent and U.S. Army veteran.

paragraphs.text: Gary Daniels lives in Milford, New Hampshire, and graduated from Milford Area High School in 1972.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1976 to 1979, the New Hampshire Army National Guard from 1979 to 1983, and the U.S. Army Reserve from 1983 to 1988.
Daniels served on the Milford School Board from 2001 to 2007, and his career experience includes working as an independent insurance agent and a certified long-term care specialist.

Daniels previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 1990 to 2000 and from 2006 to 2014, and in the New Hampshire State Senate for District 11 from 2014 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his earlier committee assignments as including chair of the Senate Finance Committee and chair of the Capital Budget Committee.
